hook: A bambusuril-coated silica captures pertechnetate from seawater at femtomolar levels.
summary: Bambusuril macrocycles bind pertechnetate, a radioactive technetium ion, in water, and anchoring them on silica gave a solid extractant that works in seawater and in nuclear medicine generator solutions. It also released the captured ion into kit formulations. The tests used lab solutions, not real waste streams.
title: Quantitative Pertechnetate Capture by a Bambusuril-based Material: From Seawater Decontamination to Radiopharmaceutical Solutions.
